Home.tagline: An Egyptian platform for pharmacists: jobs, professional verification and opportunities in one place.

Meta.title: Pharmacist Platform
Meta.description: An Arabic-first platform for pharmacists in Egypt.

Email.footer: This is an automated message from Pharmacist Platform. Please do not reply.

verification.subject: Confirm your email - Pharmacist Platform
verification.heading: Confirm your email
verification.body: Thanks for signing up. Open the link below to confirm your email address. The link is valid for 24 hours.
verification.ignore: If you did not create an account on Pharmacist Platform, ignore this message.

passwordReset.subject: Reset your password - Pharmacist Platform
passwordReset.heading: Reset your password
passwordReset.body: You asked to reset your password. Open the link below to choose a new one. The link is valid for one hour, works once, and signs you out on every device.
passwordReset.ignore: If you did not ask for this, ignore this message; your current password stays the same.

accountExists.subject: Sign-up attempt with your email - Pharmacist Platform
accountExists.heading: You already have an account
accountExists.body: Someone tried to create a new account with this email address, but you already have one. If it was you, sign in, or reset your password if you forgot it.
accountExists.ignore: If it was not you, ignore this message; nothing changed in your account.

Common.passwordHint: 10 to 128 characters. A long, memorable phrase works best.
Common.invalidEmail: Enter a valid email address, like name@example.com.

AuthErrors.invalidCredentials: The email or password is incorrect.
AuthErrors.emailNotVerified: Your email is not confirmed yet. We sent you a new confirmation link; open your inbox, then try again.
AuthErrors.passwordTooShort: The password is too short; use at least 10 characters.
AuthErrors.passwordTooLong: The password is too long; use at most 128 characters.
AuthErrors.passwordCompromised: This password appears in known data breaches. Choose a different one.
AuthErrors.invalidToken: This link is invalid, has expired or was already used.
AuthErrors.invalidCode: The code is incorrect. Check the current code in your authenticator app.
AuthErrors.invalidBackupCode: The backup code is incorrect or was already used.
AuthErrors.twoFactorExpired: The verification step timed out. Sign in again.
AuthErrors.twoFactorTooManyAttempts: Too many incorrect attempts. Sign in again to get a new attempt.
AuthErrors.accountLocked: Two-step verification is paused after too many attempts. Try again in 15 minutes.
AuthErrors.sessionNotFresh: To protect your account, sign in again and retry.
AuthErrors.unauthenticated: Your session has ended. Sign in again.
AuthErrors.rateLimited: Too many attempts in a short time. Wait a little, then try again.
AuthErrors.network: Could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
AuthErrors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again shortly.

SignUp.title: Create an account
SignUp.intro: Sign up with your email. We will send you a link to confirm it.

CheckEmail.title: Check your email
CheckEmail.body: If this email can be registered, a message will arrive within minutes. Open the link in it to confirm your email; it is valid for 24 hours. Check your spam folder too.
CheckEmail.resent: If there is an unconfirmed account with this email, we sent a new link.

VerifyEmail.title: Confirm email
VerifyEmail.success: Your email is confirmed. You can sign in now.
VerifyEmail.invalid: This confirmation link is invalid or has expired.
VerifyEmail.missing: The link is incomplete. Open the full link from the email.

SignIn.title: Sign in
SignIn.passwordReset: Your password was changed and you were signed out on every device. Sign in with the new password.
SignIn.totpIntro: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.

ForgotPassword.title: Forgot password
ForgotPassword.intro: Enter your email and we will send you a link to choose a new password.
ForgotPassword.sent: If there is an account with this email, a message will arrive within minutes. The link is valid for one hour.

ResetPassword.title: Choose a new password
ResetPassword.intro: After saving, you will be signed out on every device.
ResetPassword.missing: The link is incomplete. Open the full link from the email.

Account.title: My account

notices.staff_denied: You do not have access to the staff area.
notices.staff_mfa_required: The staff area requires two-step verification: turn it on, then sign in with it.

Account.totpExplain: Asks for a code from an authenticator app (such as Google Authenticator or Microsoft Authenticator) at every sign-in. Required for staff.
Account.setupStep1: 1. Add the account to your authenticator app: open the link on your phone, or enter the key manually.
Account.setupStep2: 2. Store the backup codes somewhere safe. Each works once and they will not be shown again.
Account.setupStep3: 3. Enter the current code from the app to finish.
Account.signOutEverywhereConfirm: You will be signed out on this device and all others. Continue?
Account.dataExplain: Download a copy of your account and profile data as JSON.

Staff.title: Staff area
Staff.body: Staff tools arrive with the admin step. Your access is protected by two-step verification.

Profile.title: My profile
Profile.intro: Your public profile is shown to signed-in members only, never to search engines. Private details are visible to you alone.
Profile.empty: You have not created your profile yet. Fill in the details below and save.
Profile.viewPublic: View my profile as members see it
Profile.profileExplain: Signed-in members see this when your profile is visible.
Profile.displayNameHint: 2 to 80 characters, in Arabic or English.
Profile.headlineHint: For example: community pharmacist, or fourth-year pharmacy student. Up to 120 characters.
Profile.yearsHint: A number from 0 to 60. Arabic digits are fine.
Profile.visibilityLegend: Who can see my public profile

visibilityHints.members: Any signed-in member can see it.
visibilityHints.hidden: No other member can see it.

Profile.detailsExplain: Only you can see these. They will be used later only when you apply for a job.
Profile.experienceExplain: Shown with your public profile. Up to 30 entries.
Profile.experienceEmpty: You have not added any experience yet.
Profile.experienceLimit: You have reached the limit of 30 entries. Delete one to add another.
Profile.deleteConfirm: Delete this experience? This cannot be undone.

ProfileErrors.invalidNumber: Enter a whole number, in Arabic or Western digits.
ProfileErrors.outOfRange: This number is outside the allowed range.
ProfileErrors.invalidChoice: Choose a value from the list.
ProfileErrors.invalidPhone: Enter a valid 11-digit Egyptian mobile number starting with 010, 011, 012 or 015.
ProfileErrors.inFuture: The date cannot be in the future.
ProfileErrors.endBeforeStart: The end date is before the start date.
ProfileErrors.validation: Check the highlighted fields and try again.
ProfileErrors.forbidden: You are not allowed to do this.
ProfileErrors.notFound: We could not find this entry; it may already be deleted. Refresh the page.
ProfileErrors.limitReached: You have reached the limit of 30 entries. Delete one to add another.
ProfileErrors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again shortly.
ProfileErrors.network: Could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.

ProfileView.title: Professional profile
ProfileView.ownerNotice: This is a preview of your profile as members see it.
ProfileView.hiddenNotice: Your profile is hidden. No one else can see it.

NotFound.title: Page not found
NotFound.body: We could not find what you are looking for. The link may be wrong or no longer available.
